ENGINE FLYWHEEL

A doppia massa, DVA (doppio volano ammortizzatore), una solidale all'albero motore e una all'albero primario del cambio con interposto un sistema elastico torsionale di smorzamento.

The resonance points, located between 800 and 2000 rpm on a conventional system, are shifted toward lower rpms, outside the service range.

The clutch engagement is located between the dual flywheel and gearbox and consists of a rigid plate (unsprung) that improves gear manoevrability due to its low inertia.
